```yaml
name: Bump openinference-instrumentation version

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'New version of openinference-instrumentation to bump to'
        required: true
        type: string
  schedule:
    # Check daily for new releases
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  bump-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get latest release version
        if: github.event_name == 'schedule'
        id: get-latest
        run: |
          LATEST_VERSION=$(curl -s https://pypi.org/pypi/openinference-instrumentation/json | jq -r '.info.version')
          echo "latest_version=$LATEST_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Determine target version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            echo "target_version=${{ github.event.inputs.version }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "target_version=${{ steps.get-latest.outputs.latest_version }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Check if version bump is needed
        id: check-bump
        run: |
          TARGET_VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.target_version }}"
          # Check if any pyproject.toml already has this version
          if grep -r "openinference-instrumentation>=$TARGET_VERSION" . --include="pyproject.toml" > /dev/null; then
            echo "already_bumped=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "already_bumped=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create branch and bump versions
        if: steps.check-bump.outputs.already_bumped == 'false'
        run: |
          TARGET_VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.target_version }}"
          BRANCH_NAME="bump-openinference-instrumentation-${TARGET_VERSION}"
          
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH_NAME"
          
          # Find all pyproject.toml files in instrumentor packages and update the dependency
          find . -name "pyproject.toml" -type f | while read -r file; do
            if grep -q "openinference-instrumentation" "$file"; then
              # Replace the version constraint for openinference-instrumentation
              # This handles formats like: openinference-instrumentation>=0.1.0
              sed -i "s/openinference-instrumentation>=[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+/openinference-instrumentation>=$TARGET_VERSION/g" "$file"
              echo "Updated $file"
            fi
          done
          
          git add .
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "chore: bump openinference-instrumentation to $TARGET_VERSION"
          git push origin "$BRANCH_NAME"

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check-bump.outputs.already_bumped == 'false'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: bump openinference-instrumentation to ${{ steps.version.outputs.target_version }}"
          title: "chore: bump openinference-instrumentation to ${{ steps.version.outputs.target_version }}"
          body: |
            This PR automatically bumps the minimum version of `openinference-instrumentation` to `${{ steps.version.outputs.target_version }}` across all Python instrumentor packages.
            
            ## Changes
            - Updated `openinference-instrumentation` dependency in all `pyproject.toml` files
            
            ## Verification
            - [ ] Verify that all instrumentor packages still build successfully
            - [ ] Verify that tests pass with the new dependency version
          branch: bump-openinference-instrumentation-${{ steps.version.outputs.target_version }}
          delete-branch: true
          base: main
```
